paragraphs: Make your business better for the environment. Save money, improve employee health, and attract customers.

sections.heading: Environmental programs › San Francisco Green Business Program
paragraphs: The City of SF promotes businesses that take extra steps to help protect our environment. Green Businesses can also get extra rebates for green purchases.

sections.heading: Environmental programs › EnergyAccess SF
paragraphs: Get a free energy assessment and help getting rebates, zero or low-interest financing, and equipment upgrades.

sections.heading: Environmental programs › Reusable Foodware for Restaurants and Cafes
paragraphs: Get up to $700 of free reusable foodware.

sections.heading: Environmental programs › Automatic Dishwashing Grant
paragraphs: Grants of up to $1,500 toward leasing or buying automatic dishwashers, to help food service businesses build reusable foodware infrastructure for on-site dining.

sections.heading: Environmental laws
paragraphs: San Francisco has several key environmental laws affecting businesses. Review the details at SF Environment.
